claim: Sample data can be reset without changing real sessions or settings.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-sandbox
sandbox: seed a real setting and session, enter ?demo=1, reset, start for real, then verify only the real namespace remains

claim: The demo opens with four populated speaking pace rehearsals.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-sample-results
sandbox: fresh /demo visit; assert named sample output, pace result, chart, and visible session list

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo, activate the service worker, set offline, and reload

claim: Free practice does not send audio or data to another origin.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-audio-processing
sandbox: record every browser request during a fresh demo export flow and assert every request is same-origin

claim: Exports practice data as JSON and CSV.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:data-export
sandbox: fresh /demo visit; inspect both downloaded files, their CSV header, and one row per saved session

claim: Set a target pace from 60 to 240 words per minute.
where: settings panel, how it works, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:pace-band
sandbox: fresh /demo visit; set both endpoint controls and verify the outputs and demo-only persistence

claim: The selected tactile test cue uses device vibration when available.
where: tap pattern control, how it works, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:haptic-cue
sandbox: fresh /demo visit with a browser vibration fixture; trigger the selected cue and record the vibration

claim: A verified $7 one-time license reveals all saved sessions and alternate tap patterns.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:paid-unlock
sandbox: fresh /demo visit with a recorded valid license response; restore the token and verify the fourth session appears in the demo namespace
